decision.case_state: Breathing Space (standard, start 01/10/2026) notified for Daniel Reyes, Flat 3, 8 Kingsland Road, arrears £3,700. Tenant proposed £100/month on top of rent. Scheduled arrears SMS (12/10) and s8 ground 8 draft review (14/10) conflict with the Breathing Space. Legal review open (ESC-104).

next_actions.action: Flag NOTE-101 on the property: no arrears SMS, no s8 draft, no payment plan accepted while the Breathing Space runs.
Tell the tenant the Breathing Space is noted, arrears contact and enforcement are paused, rent still due, the £100 proposal is not agreed and is with the legal team.
Tell the landlord about the Breathing Space, the paused reminder and notice review, and that the proposal is not accepted.
Legal team to verify the adviser independently, confirm the scope, and cancel the scheduled 12/10 SMS and 14/10 s8 review.

boundaries: Only the scheduled actions are flagged; I could not cancel them with the tools available.
The adviser's details come from the attachment only and are unverified, so I did not contact the adviser.
Accepting or refusing a payment plan is not decided here; it needs legal review and the adviser.
This does not confirm the Breathing Space is valid; that needs verification.
remaining_work: Legal to verify the Breathing Space with the adviser via an independently sourced contact (ESC-104).
Legal to cancel the scheduled 12/10 arrears SMS and 14/10 s8 draft review, or confirm they stay paused.
Ongoing rent and any repairs continue as normal.
missing_info: Verified adviser contact and confirmation of the Breathing Space
Whether an arrangement can be considered during the Breathing Space
decision.summary: A standard Breathing Space covering the £3,700 arrears is in effect from 1 October 2026, so arrears contact, enforcement and any arrears notice must stop. I flagged the scheduled arrears SMS and s8 draft, told the tenant and landlord, and escalated to legal for verification and the scheduled actions. The £100/month proposal is not accepted.

answers.question: What legal constraint applies and what can't you do?
answers.answer: A standard Breathing Space started 01/10/2026 covering the rent arrears. We cannot contact the tenant about the arrears, take enforcement action, or serve arrears notices (including the s8 ground 8 notice) while it lasts. Ongoing rent and repair contact continue.

answers.question: Can you accept the proposed payment plan?
answers.answer: No, not as an agreed arrangement. The tenant may keep paying current rent. The £100/month proposal is referred to legal and the debt adviser, and the tenant was told not to send extra payments until contacted.

answers.question: What actions and communications do you make, to whom?
answers.answer: Flagged the property note NOTE-101 (A1). Emailed the tenant (A2) and landlord Ben Hartley (A3). Escalated to legal ESC-104 (A4) to verify the adviser and cancel the scheduled 12/10 SMS and 14/10 s8 review.

actions_claimed.description: Property note NOTE-101 flagging the Breathing Space and the scheduled actions to stop
Email to tenant Daniel Reyes confirming Breathing Space noted and payment proposal not agreed
Email to landlord Ben Hartley about the Breathing Space and paused actions
Escalation ESC-104 to legal for verification and scheduled-action cancellation

failed_actions.handling: Validation error on the first call; re-sent with corrected fields and succeeded as ESC-104 (A4).

conflicts: The tenant's email says he is 2 months behind and offers to pay; the Breathing Space notice says the debt is £3,700. CRM agrees on £3,700 and 2 months, so no conflict on amount.
Scheduled arrears SMS (12/10) and s8 review (14/10) in CRM conflict with the Breathing Space; the Breathing Space takes precedence.
assumptions: The attachment is a genuine Breathing Space notice, pending legal verification.
The landlord is Ben Hartley per CRM (L-01); the notice names 'Mare & Co Lettings / landlord' as creditor.

args.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thank you for your email and for sending the letter from your debt adviser. We have noted the Breathing Space that started on 1 October 2026.

While it lasts, we will not contact you about the rent arrears, and we will not take enforcement action on them. Your current rent of £1,850 a month is still due as normal, and you can still contact us about repairs at any time.

We have not agreed your proposal of £100 a month on top of the rent. We are passing it to the right team to review, and your debt adviser can take it forward with us. Please do not send any extra payments until you hear from us.

If you need urgent help, the Money Helper service and your adviser can support you. If you are ever in danger, call 999.

Kind regards,
Lettings team, Mare & Co
